title: Data sharing — CRM has only Public / Hierarchy per module and no sharing rules

panels.caption: Module permission modal → Record visibility (API + strings)
text: Options for CRM: Public, Hierarchy (Desk also offers Public Read Only).
Hierarchy: "Users see their own records and those of lower-ranked users in their department. Unassigned records are visible to everyone. Admins see all."
Live today: Leads = hierarchy; Contacts, Deals, Accounts, Tasks, Calls, Meetings, Subscriptions = public.
